role: Can an odd-only Collatz cycle of exactly two U-steps have successive exact exponents k1=1,k2=2? Derive the cycle equation and decide whether a positive integer start exists.
public_findings: [{'answer': 'No positive integer start exists.', 'justification': 'Let n1 be the first odd value and n2 the next. Exact exponents k1=1 and k2=2 require 2n2=3n1+1 and 4n1=3n2+1. Eliminating n2 gives 8n1=9n1+5, equivalently (2^(1+2)-9)n1=3+2^1, so n1=-5. Therefore the cycle equation has no positive integer solution.'}]
